title: Epigenetic programming by H3K23ac defines lineage fate of Meg3^+ haematopoietic stem cells and drives immune ageing
technology: scRNA-seq, CITE-seq, CUT&Tag, ATAC-seq, mass spectrometry
reason: Paper presents new single-cell and multi-omics data from HSC subsets across ageing stages, with clear deposition in public repositories. Multiple batches (young, middle-aged, aged) and overlapping cell types make it suitable for cross-dataset integration and batch correction benchmarking.
methods_summary: scRNA-seq and CITE-seq using 10x Genomics platform, CUT&Tag, ATAC-seq, and mass spectrometry. Data integrated with public HSC datasets using t-SNE and UMAP.
